title: Close-Range Photogrammetric Documentation and Condition Assessment of the Ranir Snanghat, a Nineteenth-Century Zamindar Bathing Pavilion at Shoshi Lodge, Mymensingh, Bangladesh
summary: A two-storey marble bathing pavilion at the edge of an estate pond, recorded in a single day and assessed zone by zone. The survey found differential settlement — the building is moving.
subjectLabel: Ranir Snanghat — photogrammetric mesh, 49.7 million faces

figures.label: Systems
figures.value: Canon EOS 80D with EF-S 10–18 mm, and a UAV

title: A Photogrammetric Documentation and Condition Assessment of a Pala-Period Vishnu Stele in the Varendra Research Museum, Rajshahi: A Preliminary Report
summary: A thousand-year-old black stone stele found lying on burlap on an open veranda, exposed to sun and rain, with no label. The report is an iconographic reading, a damage catalogue, and a conservation emergency.

title: Reconstructing Angkor Temples from Unstructured Found Footage: A 3D Gaussian Splatting Workflow Tested on Banteay Samré and Bakong, Angkor, Cambodia
summary: Two Angkor temples reconstructed from a single publicly available video each — no site visit, no capture plan. A proof of concept for the case where photogrammetry's feature matching fails and Gaussian splatting does not.
subjectLabel: Banteay Samré and Bakong — Gaussian splats

figures.label: Stated limit
